evidence.claim: Westrock Coffee describes itself in its 2025 10-K as an integrated coffee, tea, flavors, extracts, and ingredients solutions provider serving retail, foodservice and restaurant, convenience-store and travel-center, CPG, hospitality, and private-label channels.

Westrock disclosed that no customers accounted for more than 10% of consolidated net revenues in 2025 or 2024, supporting the possibility of broad customer diversification rather than a single visible anchor customer.
As of the finance tool quote on 2026-06-16, Westrock Coffee had an indicated market capitalization of approximately $855 million, placing it in the preferred under-$1B discovery band.

TreeHouse Foods announced in June 2023 that it would acquire Farmer Brothers' Northlake, Texas coffee facility and direct-ship coffee business, adding roasting, grinding, flavoring, and blending capabilities for an end-to-end private-label coffee offering.
evidence.source_title: TreeHouse Foods to Acquire Farmer Brothers' Northlake, Texas Coffee Facility

evidence.claim: TreeHouse Foods' 2024 10-K states that the acquired coffee-roasting capability enables greater category depth in an end-to-end private-label coffee offering.

As of the finance tool quote, TreeHouse Foods had an indicated market capitalization of approximately $1.02 billion, keeping it within the small-cap discovery range rather than mega-cap restaurant-leader territory.

Farmer Brothers' fiscal 2025 10-K states that it serves customers including small independent restaurants, foodservice operators, restaurant chains, convenience-store chains, hotels, casinos, healthcare facilities, gourmet coffee houses, and retail private-brand customers.

Farmer Brothers' fiscal 2025 10-K states that its top five customers accounted for approximately 3% of net sales, suggesting broad customer distribution rather than heavy dependence on a few disclosed accounts.

As of the finance tool quote, Farmer Bros. had an indicated market capitalization of approximately $27.7 million, making it a below-$300M speculative exception rather than a standard Serenity small-cap candidate.
Coffee Holding Co.'s investor-relations profile says its core products include wholesale green coffee, private-label coffee, and branded coffee.

Coffee Holding's 2025 10-K description says it conducts wholesale coffee operations including manufacturing, roasting, packaging, marketing, and distributing roasted and blended coffees for private-label accounts and its own brands, and that a subsidiary manufactures branded and private-label coffee for retail and foodservice customers in the northeast United States.
As of the finance tool quote on 2026-06-16, Coffee Holding Co. had an indicated market capitalization of approximately $19.0 million, making it a micro-cap speculative exception.

memory_update.text: WEST is the cleanest underfollowed public-market mapping for private-label coffee, extracts, RTD, beverage development, and restaurant/foodservice beverage solutions; prioritize for Layer 2 evidence review.

THS is a useful reference/small-cap context name after acquiring Farmer Brothers' Northlake coffee facility; verify how much coffee exposure is material inside the broader private-label packaged-food portfolio.
FARM is highly node-relevant through DSD, foodservice coffee, equipment service, and restaurant/customer coverage, but market cap and likely financial fragility require speculative-shadow treatment.
JVA is a micro-cap discovery lead for private-label and wholesale coffee; restaurant exposure is plausible but weaker and must be verified through channel/customer disclosures.

The node appears investable through B2B coffee/beverage platforms, private-label manufacturing, direct-store-delivery service networks, coffee equipment/service vendors, and extract/RTD capabilities rather than only through branded coffee chains.

Need later-layer search for non-obvious public vendors in beverage formulation, aseptic/RTD co-packing, flavor/extract ingredients, restaurant coffee equipment/service, foodservice distributors' private-label coffee programs, and quality/testing/certification gates.

node: Private-label coffee, extracts, and beverage solutions
summary: Expanded the universe for the private-label coffee, extracts, and beverage-solutions node with a two-lane funnel. The strongest underfollowed public-market mappings are B2B coffee/beverage platforms that sit behind restaurant, foodservice, hospitality, convenience-store, and private-label programs rather than owning the consumer-facing restaurant brand. Westrock Coffee and TreeHouse Foods appear to be the most relevant above-$300M candidates. Farmer Brothers and Coffee Holding are high-relevance but below-$300M speculative exceptions requiring balance-sheet, cash-flow, liquidity, and customer-quality verification before surviving later Serenity layers.
